record.question: Two Government servants are involved in the same disciplinary case. The authority competent to dismiss Officer A is the Head of Department, while the authority competent to dismiss Officer B is the Secretary. Under Rule 18, who may order a common proceeding?
options: The Secretary, being the higher of the authorities competent to impose dismissal, with the consent of the Head of Department
The Secretary, only after the President formally delegates disciplinary powers for both officers
The Head of Department, since one of the officers is under his disciplinary control
The authority proposed to act as the common disciplinary authority, after recording reasons in writing
